Does Imipenem-cilastatin less develop/worsen AKI than other carbapenems?

__

  • Patients in MIMIC3, MIMIC4, AUMC

  • Those treated with imipenem/cilastatin (I/C group) vs non-cilastatin carbapenems (NCC group)

  • Primary outcome is development or progression of AKI (compare AKI stage at treatment start and after treatment start)

  • Using propensity score overlap weighting to adjust patients backgrounds.

  • Using random mixed effect meta-analysis to combine the results of each dataset.

__

Results (background and outcomes)

_

1. Backgrounds and outcome development of the patients (before matching)

Patient characteristics and outcome development in 7 days.

“O,” are the outcomes. Primary outcome is “AKI development or progression”

library(cobalt) #install.packages("cobalt")
library(pROC)
library(MatchIt) #install.packages("MatchIt")
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary) #install.packages("tableone")
SELECTS <- c("dataset", "age_cat", "age_group", "sex", "bmi", "weight","drug_type", "Imipenem.Cilastatin", "Imipenem.Cilastatin.Relebactam", "time_switch_group", "dep_type",  "time_ICUadmit_to_abx", "pre_blood_culture", "nt_drug", "treat_van", "treat_AG", "treat_NSAIDs", "treat_RADIOC","vasopressor", "ventilation", "sofa","qsofa", "sirs", "sep3", "base_crea", "near_crea","base_KDIGO", "obs_period", "base_KDIGO_dial", "base_KDIGO_dial", "outcome_KDIGO", "outcome_new_dial", "outcome_KDIGO_inc", "death_in_7d", "outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death",  "outcome_max_crea_ratio", "outcome_max_crea_diff", "death_in_hosp", "drug", "total_dose_ICM", "total_dose_recabrio", "total_dose_erta","total_dose_dori", "ini24h_dose_ICM", "ini24h_dose_recabrio","ini24h_dose_erta", "ini24h_dose_dori","last_drug_in_obs") #"ph_htn", "ph_dm", "ph_chf", "ph_ckd", "Meropenem", "Doripenem", "Ertapenem", "los_icu", 

#combine 3 datasets
comb_DF <- rbind(
  read.csv("MDF_mimic3.csv") %>% mutate(dataset="MIMIC3", cardiac_surgery=TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(SELECTS, hadm_id) %>% rename("ID"=hadm_id), 
  read.csv("MDF_aumc.csv") %>% mutate(dataset="AUMC", ph_htn=NA, ph_dm=NA, ph_chf=NA, ph_ckd=NA) %>% dplyr::select(SELECTS, icustay_id) %>% rename("ID"=icustay_id) 
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
  read.csv("MDF_miiv.csv") %>% mutate(dataset="miiv") %>% dplyr::select(SELECTS, hadm_id) %>% rename("ID"=hadm_id)
  ) 

comb_DF$base_KDIGO_dial <- ifelse(is.na(comb_DF$base_KDIGO_dial), F, 
                                  ifelse(comb_DF$base_KDIGO_dial>0.5, T, F))
comb_DF$dep_type2 <- ifelse(is.na(comb_DF$dep_type), "Non-surgery", ifelse(comb_DF$dep_type=="surg", "Surgery", "Non-surgery"))
comb_DF$drug_type <- ifelse(comb_DF$drug_type=="IMI", "I/C", "NCC")
comb_DF$sep3 <- ifelse(is.na(comb_DF$sep3), FALSE, ifelse(comb_DF$sep3==TRUE, TRUE, FALSE))
comb_DF$drug01 <- ifelse(comb_DF$drug_type=="I/C", 1 , 0) #convert to 0/1 for matching
comb_DF$drug10 <- ifelse(comb_DF$drug_type=="I/C", 0 , 1)
comb_DF$drug_switch <- ifelse(comb_DF$time_switch_group<168, T, F)
comb_DF$outcome_HDD_in7d <- ifelse(comb_DF$outcome_new_dial==TRUE, TRUE,
                                   ifelse(comb_DF$death_in_7d==TRUE, TRUE, FALSE))
comb_DF$drug_name <- ifelse(grepl("relebactam", comb_DF$drug), "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam", 
                      ifelse(grepl("rtapenem", comb_DF$drug), "Ertapenem",
                       ifelse(grepl("Doripenem", comb_DF$drug), "Doripenem",
                        ifelse(grepl("mipenem", comb_DF$drug), "Imipenem/cilastatin",
                         ifelse(grepl("eropenem", comb_DF$drug), "Meropenem", F))))) %>% factor(levels = c("Imipenem/cilastatin", "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam","Meropenem", "Doripenem", "Ertapenem"))

comb_DF$treat_RADIOC <- ifelse(!is.na(comb_DF$treat_RADIOC), T, F)
comb_DF$treat_NSAIDs <- ifelse(!is.na(comb_DF$treat_NSAIDs), T, F)
comb_DF$treat_AG <- ifelse(!is.na(comb_DF$treat_AG), T, F)
comb_DF$weight <- comb_DF$weight %>% as.numeric()

#calculate eGFR at treatment start (with CKD-EPI Creatinine Equation 2021)
comb_DF$eGFR_a <- ifelse(comb_DF$sex=="Female", -0.241, -0.302)
comb_DF$eGFR_k <- ifelse(comb_DF$sex=="Female", 0.7, 0.9)
comb_DF$eGFR_t <- ifelse(comb_DF$sex=="Female", 1.012, 1)
comb_DF$near_eGFR <- 142*pmin(comb_DF$near_crea/comb_DF$eGFR_k, 1)^comb_DF$eGFR_a *
                         pmax(comb_DF$near_crea/comb_DF$eGFR_k, 1)^-1.2 *
                         0.9938^comb_DF$age_cat * comb_DF$eGFR_t
#check eGFR calculation results
#ggplot(comb_DF, aes(near_eGFR, base_crea))+geom_point(size=0.5)+geom_smooth(se=T)

#Assess overdose or not and scaled dose for eGFR of each subject (according to Drugs.com)
comb_DF <- comb_DF %>%
  mutate(
    dose_status = case_when(
      # --- MEROPENEM CRITERIA ---
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 50 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 3000 ~ "over", #1g*3
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 25 & near_eGFR < 50 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 2000 ~ "over", #1g*2
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 10 & near_eGFR < 25 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 1000 ~ "over", #500mg*2
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR <  10 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 500 ~ "over", #500mg*1
      drug_name == "Meropenem" ~ "not_over",
      # --- I/C CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 90  & ini24h_dose_ICM > 3000 ~ "over", #1g*3
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 60 & near_eGFR < 90 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 2000 ~ "over", #500mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 60 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 1500 ~ "over", #500mg*3
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 15 & near_eGFR < 30 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 1000 ~ "over", #500mg*2
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR < 15 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 0  ~ "over",  #not recommended
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin" ~ "not_over",
       # --- Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 90  & ini24h_dose_recabrio > 5000 ~ "over", #1250mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 60 & near_eGFR < 90 & ini24h_dose_recabrio > 4000 ~ "over",#1g*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 60 & ini24h_dose_recabrio > 3000 ~ "over",#750mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 15 & near_eGFR < 30 & ini24h_dose_recabrio > 2000 ~ "over",#500mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR < 15 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 0  ~ "over", #not recommended
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam" ~ "not_over",
      # --- Doripenem CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR >= 50  & ini24h_dose_dori > 1500 ~ "over", #500mg*3
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 50 & ini24h_dose_dori > 750 ~ "over", #250mg*3
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR < 30 & ini24h_dose_dori > 500  ~ "over", #250mg*2
      drug_name == "Doripenem" ~ "not_over",
      # --- Ertapenem CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Ertapenem"  & near_eGFR >= 30  & ini24h_dose_erta > 1000 ~ "over", #1g*1
      drug_name == "Ertapenem"  & near_eGFR < 30 & ini24h_dose_erta > 500  ~ "over",  #500mg*1
      drug_name == "Ertapenem" ~ "not_over",
      # --- CATCH-ALL FOR OTHER DRUGS ---
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )) %>% 
  mutate(
    dose_status2 = case_when(
      # --- MEROPENEM CRITERIA ---
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 50 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/3000 %>% as.numeric(),  #1g*3
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 25 & near_eGFR < 50 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/2000 , #1g*2
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR >= 10 & near_eGFR < 25 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/1000, #500mg*2
      drug_name == "Meropenem" & near_eGFR <  10 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/500, #500mg*1
      # --- I/C CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 90  ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/3000, #1g*3
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 60 & near_eGFR < 90 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/2000, #500mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 60 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/1500, #500mg*3
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR >= 15 & near_eGFR < 30 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/1000, #500mg*2
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin"  & near_eGFR < 15 ~ ini24h_dose_ICM/500,  #not recommended
       # --- Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 90  ~ ini24h_dose_recabrio/5000, #1250mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 60 & near_eGFR < 90 ~ ini24h_dose_recabrio/4000, #1g*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 60 ~ ini24h_dose_recabrio/3000, #750mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR >= 15 & near_eGFR < 30 ~ ini24h_dose_recabrio/2000, #500mg*4
      drug_name == "Imipenem/cilastatin/relebactam"  & near_eGFR < 15 & ini24h_dose_ICM > 0  ~ 100, #not recommended
      # --- Doripenem CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR >= 50  ~ ini24h_dose_dori/1500, #500mg*3
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR >= 30 & near_eGFR < 50 ~ ini24h_dose_dori/750, #250mg*3
      drug_name == "Doripenem"  & near_eGFR < 30 ~ ini24h_dose_dori/500, #250mg*2
      # --- Ertapenem CRITERIA 
      drug_name == "Ertapenem"  & near_eGFR >= 30 ~ ini24h_dose_erta/1000, #1g*1
      drug_name == "Ertapenem"  & near_eGFR < 30 ~ ini24h_dose_erta/500,  #500mg*1
      # --- CATCH-ALL FOR OTHER DRUGS ---
      TRUE ~ NA
    )) 

VARS <-c("dataset","age_group", "sex", "bmi", "weight",  "dep_type2", "drug_name", "dose_status", "dose_status2", "sofa", "qsofa", "sirs",  "pre_blood_culture", "nt_drug", "treat_van", "treat_AG", "treat_NSAIDs", "treat_RADIOC","vasopressor", "ventilation","base_crea", "near_crea","base_KDIGO", "near_eGFR",  "obs_period", "drug_switch","base_KDIGO_dial", "outcome_KDIGO_inc", "death_in_7d", "outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death", "outcome_new_dial", "outcome_HDD_in7d", "total_dose_ICM", "total_dose_recabrio", "total_dose_erta","total_dose_dori", "ini24h_dose_ICM", "ini24h_dose_recabrio","ini24h_dose_erta", "ini24h_dose_dori","last_drug_in_obs") #"ph_htn", "ph_dm", "ph_chf", "ph_ckd", "sep3","los_icu", "death_in_hosp", "outcome_max_crea_ratio", "outcome_max_crea_diff"
###Ppatietns with base_KDIGO 3 is excluded.
comb_DF2 <- comb_DF %>% filter(base_KDIGO<2.9)
CONTIN <- c("weight","qsofa", "sirs", "total_dose_ICM", "total_dose_recabrio", "total_dose_erta","total_dose_dori", "ini24h_dose_ICM", "ini24h_dose_recabrio","ini24h_dose_erta", "ini24h_dose_dori", "last_drug_in_obs", "obs_period", "dose_status2")

l_list <- list(dep_type2~"ICU type", treat_van~"pre vancomycin use", treat_NSAIDs~"pre NSAIDs use", treat_RADIOC~"pre contrast agent use",treat_AG~"pre aminoglycosied use",vasopressor~"pre vasopressor use", ventilation~"pre ventilation", base_crea~"Baseline sCr", near_crea~"sCr at treatment start", base_KDIGO~"AKI stage at treatment start", obs_period~"observation time", drug_switch~"Cencsored with drug change", base_KDIGO_dial~"RRT at treatment start", outcome_KDIGO_inc~"O, AKI develop/progress", death_in_7d~"O, Death", outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death~"O, AKI d/p or death", outcome_new_dial~"O, RRT-intervention", outcome_HDD_in7d~"O, Death or RRT-intervention", nt_drug~"pre nephrotoxic drugs use", dose_status~"Overdose in first 24h", dose_status2~"Relative initiation dose (with near eGFR)")

#MIMIC3 pts, base_KDIGO<2.9
tbl_summary(comb_DF2 %>% subset(dataset=="MIMIC3"), by=drug_type, include = VARS, type = list(CONTIN ~ "continuous"), digits = list(all_categorical()~ 1, all_continuous() ~ 1), label = l_list) %>% add_p(pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)) %>% modify_spanning_header(update = all_stat_cols() ~ "**MIMIC-III, base_KDIGO<3**")

2. Matching by normal matching (Not used -> Hidden)

Next, backgrounds are adjusted using (normal) propensity score matching. Since normal matching cannot adjust the backgrounds enough in some datasets, results with such normal matching were not used for the manuscript.

2a. Backgourns and outcome with (normal) propensity score matching (Hidden)

2b. Visualize the quality of matching (Hidden. ROC were around 0.6, total SMD were fine with MIMIC3&4 but 0.18 with AUMC)

2c. check creatinine change before and after matching (Hidden)

#creatinine change from 1st-penem (before PSM)

c0 <- ggplot(m4_crea4, aes(time_1stabx_to_crea, crea, color=drug_type))+theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth()+xlim(c(-168, 168))+theme(legend.position = "bottom")+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 2))+geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+ggtitle("MIMIC4 w/o PSM")

  geom_smooth()+xlim(c(-168, 168))+theme(legend.position = "bottom")+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 2))+geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+ggtitle("MIMIC3 w/o PSM")

  geom_smooth()+xlim(c(-168, 168))+theme(legend.position = "bottom")+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 2))+geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+ggtitle("MIMIC4 w/ PSM")

       aes(time_abx_to_crea, crea, color=drug_type))+theme_classic()+

library(ggrepel)
for (i in c(62,15)) {
data_n6 <- aumc_crea44 %>% group_by(admissionid) %>% summarise("count"=n()) %>% filter(count>5)
data <- aumc_crea44 %>% subset(admissionid %in% data_n6$admissionid) %>% subset(admissionid %in% matched_AUMC_DF$ID)
data_one_subject <- data %>% subset(admissionid == data$admissionid %>% unique() %>% .[i])
ID <- data_one_subject$admissionid %>% unique()
g<-ggplot(data_one_subject, aes(time_abx_to_crea, crea))+
  theme_classic()+ 
  geom_point()+geom_line()+
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = round(crea, digits=1)))+
  xlim(c(-180, 180))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-168,0,48,168))+
  labs(x="Time from the 1st carbapenem treatment (h)", y="Serum creatinine levels (mg/dL)")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x =  element_text("ccc"))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(data_one_subject$crea)*1.2))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray30")+
    geom_vline(xintercept=-168, linetype="dashed", color="gray80")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=48, linetype="dashed", color="gray80")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=168, linetype="dashed", color="gray80")+
  ggtitle(paste0(i," [ID:",ID, "], KDIGO by crea: ", data_one_subject$base_KDIGO_crea, " -> ", 
                 max(data_one_subject %>% subset(time_abx_to_crea>0) %>% .$outcome_KDIGO_crea, na.rm = T), " (by max), HD_start: ", comb_DF2 %>% subset(ID %in% 3034) %>% .$outcome_new_dial %>% unique()))
  print(g)
  data_n6
}

__

3. Overlap weighting

Propensity score for I/C group was calculated with age, sex, ICU type, SIRS, pre blood culture, pre vancomycin use, pre vasopressor use, baseline sCr, sCr at treatment start and AKI stage at treatment start. Then the overlap weighting was performed on each dataset based on the propensity scores.

__

3a. backgrounds and outcome development after overlap weighting

#OVERLAP_PSM
library(WeightIt) #install.packages("WeightIt")
library(PSweight) #install.packages("PSweight")
library(survey) #install.packages("survey")
comb_DF2ovl <- comb_DF2 %>% as.data.frame()# %>% subset(data=="MIMIC3")

FORMULA_ovl <- drug01 ~ age_cat + sex  + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture+ nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea + base_KDIGO 
FORMULA_ovl2 <- drug01 ~  age_cat + sex + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture + nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea +  base_KDIGO
#dig2s <- c("outcome_max_crea_ratio", "outcome_max_crea_diff","base_crea", "near_crea")

#Create function to do calculating PS, weighing, and showing table.
OVLP<-function(DF0, FORM, TITLE, TITLE2){
DF<-DF0  
bal_ovlp <- PSweight::SumStat(ps.formula = FORM, data = DF, weight="overlap")
ps_man <- glm(formula = FORM, data=DF, family = binomial) %>% .$fitted.values
wgt_man <- DF %>% mutate(ps_for_IMI = ps_man, ovlp_wgt = case_when(drug01 == 1 ~ (1-ps_man), drug01 == 0 ~ ps_man))
saveRDS(bal_ovlp, paste0("bal_ovlp", TITLE, ".rds"))
saveRDS(wgt_man, paste0("wgt_man_", TITLE, ".rds"))

svydesign(~1, data = wgt_man %>% as.data.frame(), weights = wgt_man$ovlp_wgt) %>% tbl_svysummary(include = VARS, by=drug_type, type = list(CONTIN ~ "continuous"), digits = list(all_categorical() ~ 1, all_continuous() ~ 1), label = l_list) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)) %>%
  modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}** N={style_number(n, scale = 1, digits = 1)}") %>% 
  modify_spanning_header(update = all_stat_cols() ~ TITLE2)
}
#1. overlap-PSM using MIMIC3
OVLP(comb_DF2ovl %>% subset(dataset=="MIMIC3"), FORMULA_ovl2, "Ovlp_MIMIC3", "**Ovlp, MIMIC-III, base_KDIGO<3**")

#Checking histogram of propensity score
HISTO <- function(DF, TITLE, MARK){
ggplot(DF, aes(ps_for_IMI, group = drug_type, fill=drug_type))+
    geom_histogram(color="black", data = DF %>% subset(drug_type=="I/C"), aes(y=..count..))+
    geom_histogram(color="black", data = DF %>% subset(drug_type!="I/C"), aes(y=-..count..))+
    theme_classic()+
    labs(title =  TITLE, x="Propensity score for I/C group", y="Counts")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0), axis.title.x = element_text(size=10.5))}

tiff("eFigure 1 (histogram).tif", res = 300, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", compression = "lzw")
gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  HISTO(readRDS("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3.rds"), "(a) MIMIC-III"), 
  HISTO(readRDS("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4.rds"), "(b) MIMIC-IV"),
  HISTO(readRDS("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC.rds"), "(c) AUMC"), nrow=2)
dev.off()

3c. Forest plot of the primary outcomes in each dataset and of overall result

_

#calculating Odds ratio of I/C group in each dataset (not needed)
library(forestplot)
OVLP_OR <- function(DF, FORM, OUTCOME, TITLE){
est_ovlp <- PSweight(ps.formula = FORM, yname = OUTCOME, data = DF, weight = "overlap")
summary1 <- est_ovlp %>% summary(type="OR") %>% .$estimates %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(
      OR = exp(Estimate),
      LCI = exp(lwr),
      UCI = exp(upr),
      study = TITLE,
      outcome = OUTCOME
  )
svy_design <- svydesign(~1, data = DF %>% as.data.frame(), weights = DF$ovlp_wgt)
fmla <- as.formula(paste("~", OUTCOME))
summary1 <- summary1 %>% mutate("pts"= svytable(fmla, svy_design) %>% as.data.frame() %>% .$Freq %>% sum(),
                                "events"=svytable(fmla, svy_design) %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(.data[[OUTCOME]]==T) %>% .$Freq %>% sum())
summary1
}
#calculating Odds ratio of I/C group in each dataset
FP2 <- function(RDS, FORM){
OR_RES <- rbind(
  OVLP_OR(readRDS(RDS), FORM, "outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death", "AKI progression or death"),
  OVLP_OR(readRDS(RDS), FORM, "outcome_KDIGO_inc", "AKI progression"),
  OVLP_OR(readRDS(RDS), FORM, "outcome_new_dial", "Hemodialysis"),
  OVLP_OR(readRDS(RDS), FORM, "death_in_7d", "Death"),
  OVLP_OR(readRDS(RDS), FORM, "outcome_HDD_in7d", "Hemodialysis or death")) %>% 
  mutate("events_percentage"=events/sum(.$event), "pts_percentage"=pts/sum(.$pts))
saveRDS(OR_RES, paste0("ORRES_",RDS))
}

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4.rds", FORMULA_ovl2)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3.rds", FORMULA_ovl2)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC.rds", FORMULA_ovl2)
#Pool the results of each dataset with Random Mixed effect meta-analysis
METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
METADF_AKID <- METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
METADF_AKI <- METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
METADF_HD <- METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
METADF_D <- METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
METADF_HDD <- METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")


library(metafor)
METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = METADF_AKID)
METARES_AKI <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = METADF_AKI)
METARES_HD <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = METADF_HD)
METARES_D <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = METADF_D)
METARES_HDD <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = METADF_HDD)

METAF <- function(METARES, AAA, BBB, CCC, TITLE){
metafor::forest(METARES,  atransf=exp, at=log(AAA), slab = dataset,
       xlim=BBB,
       ilab=cbind(round(pts, digits=1), round(events, digits=1)), 
       ilab.lab=c("Subjects","Events"), ilab.pos = 2, ilab.xpos=CCC,
       cex=0.85, header="", xlab="Odds ratio", mlab="Total (Random effects model)", shade=TRUE, 
       main=TITLE, adj=0)
}

base0_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_base0.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_base0.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_base0.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
base0_METADF_AKID <- base0_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
base0_METADF_AKI <- base0_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
base0_METADF_HD <- base0_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
base0_METADF_D <- base0_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
base0_METADF_HDD <- base0_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")
base0_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base0_METADF_AKID)
base0_METARES_AKI<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base0_METADF_AKI)
base0_METARES_HD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base0_METADF_HD)
base0_METARES_D<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base0_METADF_D)
base0_METARES_HDD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base0_METADF_HDD)

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_Male.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_sex)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_Male.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_sex)

Male_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_Male.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_Male.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_Male.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
Male_METADF_AKID <- Male_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
Male_METADF_AKI <- Male_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
Male_METADF_HD <- Male_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
Male_METADF_D <- Male_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
Male_METADF_HDD <- Male_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")
Male_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Male_METADF_AKID)
Male_METARES_AKI<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Male_METADF_AKI)
Male_METARES_HD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Male_METADF_HD)
Male_METARES_D<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Male_METADF_D)
Male_METARES_HDD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Male_METADF_HDD)

METAF(Male_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (Male)")

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_Old.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_age)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_Old.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_age)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_Old.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_age)

Old_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_Old.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_Old.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_Old.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
Old_METADF_AKID <- Old_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
Old_METADF_AKI <- Old_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
Old_METADF_HD <- Old_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
Old_METADF_D <- Old_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
Old_METADF_HDD <- Old_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")

Old_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Old_METADF_AKID)
Old_METARES_AKI <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Old_METADF_AKI)
Old_METARES_HD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Old_METADF_HD)
Old_METARES_D <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Old_METADF_D)
Old_METARES_HDD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = Old_METADF_HDD)

METAF(Old_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (older than 59 years)")

Old_METARES_AKI

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_nt.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_nt)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_nt.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_nt)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_nt.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_nt)

nt_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_nt.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_nt.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_nt.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
nt_METADF_AKID <- nt_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
nt_METADF_AKI <- nt_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
nt_METADF_HD <- nt_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
nt_METADF_D <- nt_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
nt_METADF_HDD <- nt_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")
nt_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nt_METADF_AKID)
nt_METARES_AKI<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nt_METADF_AKI)
nt_METARES_HD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nt_METADF_HD)
nt_METARES_D<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nt_METADF_D)
nt_METARES_HDD<-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nt_METADF_HDD)

METAF(nt_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (Treated with nephrotoxic drug)")

nt_METARES_AKI

#Forrestplot
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_bc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_bc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_bc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)

bc_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_bc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_bc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_bc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
bc_METADF_AKID <- bc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
bc_METADF_AKI <- bc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
bc_METADF_HD <- bc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
bc_METADF_D <- bc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
bc_METADF_HDD <- bc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")
bc_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = bc_METADF_AKID)
bc_METARES_AKI <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = bc_METADF_AKI)
bc_METARES_HD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = bc_METADF_HD)
bc_METARES_D <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = bc_METADF_D)
bc_METARES_HDD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = bc_METADF_HDD)

METAF(bc_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (with blood culture)")

bc_METARES_AKI

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_nonbc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_nonbc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_nonbc.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_bc)

nonbc_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_nonbc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_nonbc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_nonbc.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
nonbc_METADF_AKID <- nonbc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
nonbc_METADF_AKI <- nonbc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
nonbc_METADF_HD <- nonbc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
nonbc_METADF_D <- nonbc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
nonbc_METADF_HDD <- nonbc_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")

nonbc_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nonbc_METADF_AKID)
nonbc_METARES_AKI <-rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nonbc_METADF_AKI)
nonbc_METARES_HD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nonbc_METADF_HD)
nonbc_METARES_D <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nonbc_METADF_D)
nonbc_METARES_HDD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = nonbc_METADF_HDD)

METAF(nonbc_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (Non-BC)")

FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_vaso.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_vaso)
FP2("wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_vaso.rds", FORMULA_ovl2_vaso)

vaso_METADF0 <- rbind(
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_vaso.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_vaso.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_vaso.rds") %>% mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))
vaso_METADF_AKID <- vaso_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc_or_death")
vaso_METADF_AKI <- vaso_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_KDIGO_inc")
vaso_METADF_HD <- vaso_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
vaso_METADF_D <- vaso_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="death_in_7d")
vaso_METADF_HDD <- vaso_METADF0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_HDD_in7d")
vaso_METARES_AKID <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = vaso_METADF_AKID)
vaso_METARES_AKI <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = vaso_METADF_AKI)
vaso_METARES_HD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = vaso_METADF_HD)
vaso_METARES_D <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = vaso_METADF_D)
vaso_METARES_HDD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = vaso_METADF_HDD)

METAF(vaso_METARES_AKI, SCALEA1, SCALEB1, SCALEC1, "(a) AKI development/progression (with vasopressor)")

12. Firth’s regression -> forest plot.

In some subgroup analyses, outcomes only developed one group. Then, we couldn’t estimate odds ratio. Therefore, we estimated the ratio using Firth’s regression

#Firth's method function
library(logistf) #install.packages("logistf")
DF <- readRDS("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_base12.rds")
DF$drug_type <- DF$drug_type %>% factor() %>% relevel(, ref = "NCC")
saveRDS(DF,"wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_base12.rds")
#logistf(formula = as.formula("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~ drug_type"), data  = readRDS("wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_base12.rds"), weights = ovlp_wgt)

OVLP_OR_F <- function(DF, FORM, OUTCOME, TITLE){
fit <- logistf(formula = as.formula(paste0(OUTCOME," ~ drug_type")), data  = DF, weights = ovlp_wgt)
fit %>% summary() %>% print()
est<-coef(fit)["drug_typeI/C"]
ci<-confint(fit)["drug_typeI/C", ]
summary1 <- data.frame(Estimate = est, Std.Error = (ci[2] - ci[1]) / (2 * 1.96), lwr=ci[1], upr=ci[2], 
                       study=TITLE, outcome=OUTCOME)
svy_design <- svydesign(~1, data = DF %>% as.data.frame(), weights = DF$ovlp_wgt)
fmla <- as.formula(paste("~", OUTCOME))
summary1 <- summary1 %>% mutate("pts"= svytable(fmla, svy_design) %>% as.data.frame() %>% .$Freq %>% sum(),
                                "events"=svytable(fmla, svy_design) %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(.data[[OUTCOME]]==T) %>% .$Freq %>% sum())
summary1
}

FP2_F <- function(RDS, FORM,  OUTCOME, TITLE){
OR_RES_F <- OVLP_OR_F(readRDS(RDS), FORM, OUTCOME, TITLE) %>% 
  mutate("events_percentage"=events/sum(.$event), "pts_percentage"=pts/sum(.$pts))
saveRDS(OR_RES_F, paste0("ORRES_F_",RDS))}

## Wald test = 12.1069 on 1 df, p = 0.0005023564logistf(formula = as.formula(paste0(OUTCOME, " ~ drug_type")), 
##     data = DF, weights = ovlp_wgt)
## Model fitted by Penalized ML
## Confidence intervals and p-values by Profile Likelihood 
## 
## Coefficients:
##  (Intercept) drug_typeI/C 
##   -2.6464967   -0.7342704 
## 
## Likelihood ratio test=0.1822875 on 1 df, p=0.6694148, n=28.39331
base12_METADF_F0 <- rbind( #Firth method only used for MIMIC3
  readRDS("ORRES_F_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC3_base12.rds") %>% dplyr::select(Estimate, Std.Error, outcome, pts, events) %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-III"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_MIMIC4_base12.rds") %>% dplyr::select(Estimate, Std.Error, outcome, pts, events) %>% mutate("dataset"="MIMIC-IV"),
  readRDS("ORRES_wgt_man_Ovlp_AUMC_base12.rds") %>% dplyr::select(Estimate, Std.Error, outcome, pts, events) %>%mutate("dataset"="AUMC"))

base12_METADF_F_HD <- base12_METADF_F0 %>% subset(outcome=="outcome_new_dial")
base12_METARES_F_HD <- rma(yi = Estimate, sei = Std.Error, method = "REML", data = base12_METADF_F_HD)

base12_METARES_F_HD

METAF2 <- function(METARES, AAA, BBB,TITLE){
metafor::forest(METARES,  atransf=exp, at=log(AAA), slab = dataset,
       xlim=BBB, 
       #ilab=cbind(round(pts, digits=1), round(events, digits=1)), 
       #ilab.lab=c("Subjects","Events"), ilab.pos = 2,
       #ilab.xpos=CCC,
       cex=0.85, cex.axis=0.7, annotate=T,
       header="", xlab="Odds ratio", mlab="Overall", shade=TRUE, 
       main=TITLE, adj=0)
}

14. Post hoc analysis for revision

Logistic regression model adjusting for baseline factors, relative carbapenem dose in first 24h, and treatment duration

__

phDF_m3 <- comb_DF2 %>% subset(dataset=="MIMIC3")
phDF_m4 <- comb_DF2 %>% subset(dataset=="miiv")
phDF_aumc <- comb_DF2 %>% subset(dataset=="AUMC")

#Crude model
LG <- rbind(
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", "drug01"), data = phDF_m3, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T), 
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", "drug01"), data = phDF_m4, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", "drug01"), data = phDF_aumc, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T)) %>% 
  subset(term=="drug01") %>% mutate(dataset=c("MIMIC-III", "MIMIC-IV", "AUMC"), model="Crude")

#Model 1<- adjusted with base factors which were used for PSM
PHvars1 <- "drug01 + age_cat + sex + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture + nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea + base_KDIGO"
LG1 <- rbind(
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars1), data = phDF_m3, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars1), data = phDF_m4, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars1), data = phDF_aumc, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T)) %>%
  subset(term=="drug01") %>% mutate(dataset=c("MIMIC-III", "MIMIC-IV", "AUMC"), model="Model 1")

#Model 2 <- adjusted with base factors and relative carbapenem dose at first 24h (dose_status2)
PHvars2 <- "drug01 + dose_status2 + age_cat + sex + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture + nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea + base_KDIGO"

LG2 <- rbind(
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars2), data = phDF_m3, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars2), data = phDF_m4, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars2), data = phDF_aumc, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T)) %>% 
  subset(term=="drug01") %>% mutate(dataset=c("MIMIC-III", "MIMIC-IV", "AUMC"), model="Model 2")

#Model 3 <- adjusted with base factors and treatment duration
PHvars3 <- "drug01 + last_drug_in_obs + age_cat + sex + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture + nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea + base_KDIGO"
LG3 <- rbind(
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars3), data = phDF_m3, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars3), data = phDF_m4, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars3), data = phDF_aumc, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T)) %>%
  subset(term=="drug01") %>% mutate(dataset=c("MIMIC-III", "MIMIC-IV", "AUMC"), model="Model 3")

#Model 4 <- adjusted with base factors, relative dose at first 24h, and treatment duration
PHvars4 <- "drug01 + dose_status2 + last_drug_in_obs + age_cat + sex + dep_type2 + sirs + pre_blood_culture + nt_drug + vasopressor + base_crea + near_crea + base_KDIGO"
LG4 <- rbind(
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars4), data = phDF_m3, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars4), data = phDF_m4, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T),
  glm(formula=paste("outcome_KDIGO_inc ~", PHvars4), data = phDF_aumc, family = binomial(link = "logit")) %>% broom::tidy(exponentiate = T, conf.int = T)) %>%
  subset(term=="drug01") %>% mutate(dataset=c("MIMIC-III", "MIMIC-IV", "AUMC"), model="Model 4")

comb_LG <- rbind(LG, LG1, LG2, LG3, LG4) %>% 
  mutate(OR_fmt = round(estimate, 2),
         lower_fmt = round(conf.low, 2),
         upper_fmt = round(conf.high, 2),
         p_fmt = round(p.value, 3),
         table=paste0(OR_fmt, " [", lower_fmt, ", ", upper_fmt, "]"))

comb_LG %>% subset(dataset=="MIMIC-III") %>% dplyr::select(model, table, p_fmt) %>% arrange(model) %>% rename("MIMIC-III"="model")
